verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Superhuman automatically reminds you to follow up when an email needs a response, with a draft ready, and its MCP workflow can check read status and draft nudges. This covers the resurfacing-if-no-reply half of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions snoozing conversations. Missing for 10: any evidence of snooze, documentation of how reminders resurface threads or can be timed by the user, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
